issue.title: Enable merge queue on main (optional)
issue.body:
## Parent

Part of #420 (Phase 4). Do not close #420 from this ticket. Maintainer GitHub settings + required checks — optional until merge volume justifies it.

## Scope

Enable merge queue on `main` so approved PRs are tested against the *would-be* main instead of every developer rebasing after each dep merge.

Requires required status checks to be real (today only `PR Description` is required in branch protection — see `docs/ci.md`). Do **not** enable the queue until lint/test/typecheck (and the Expo checks we still want) are required, or the queue tests the wrong bar.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Required checks include lint, test, typecheck, and the Expo checks we still want on PRs.
- [ ] Merge queue enabled on `main` (or this ticket closed as not planned if volume does not justify it).
- [ ] `docs/ci.md` updated.

## Out of scope

Dependabot Expo/RN split (Phase 3), weekday Expo `--fix` bot (Phase 2).
